proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Initially reported ambiguity, then selected BVX after repeated evaluator demands for one answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected ambiguity reports and required exactly one intended answer.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer despite underdetermination, choose a candidate rather than reiterating ambiguity.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Select one valid candidate, preferably the previously submitted BVX, and output only that answer.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues admitted both BVX and BXV, so the intended ordering was not derivable from the available information.
